title: Strawberry and Rhubarb Lattice Tart
changes_from_base: Rhubarb and strawberries baked under a pastry lattice instead of fresh strawberries over crème pâtissière.
summary: Rhubarb and strawberries with brown sugar and cinnamon, baked under a sugared pastry lattice.

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt
strawberries, hulled and halved or quartered

steps.title: Pastry
steps.text: heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan). Pulse the flour and salt, add the butter and pulse until pebbly. Beat the yolks with the iced water, sprinkle over and pulse 10-12 times, until a dough starts to form.

steps.title: Divide
steps.text: gather the dough and set a third aside for the lattice. Roll the rest on a floured surface and line the tin. Keep the lattice dough in the fridge while the case bakes.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: line with paper and beans and bake on the tray about 10 min, until dry-looking. Remove the paper and beans and bake about 20 min more, until lightly browned.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: mix the rhubarb, strawberries, brown sugar, cinnamon, cornflour and melted butter in the large bowl and spoon into the case, juices and all.

steps.title: Lattice
steps.text: roll the reserved dough and cut 2.5 cm strips. Weave them over the fruit and tuck the ends in at the edge. Beat the egg white with 1 tbsp water, brush the strips and sprinkle with the caster sugar.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: about 40 min on the tray, until the lattice is browned and the filling bubbles thickly in the centre. Cool at least 1 h so the juices set, then serve with crème fraîche. The filling must bubble in the middle so the cornflour thickens.

tips: Use thin, pink forced rhubarb for the best colour.
Set the tin on a tray; some juice will bubble over.
Leftover pastry strips can be baked with sugar as cook's treats.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for 1 day, or chill for up to 3 days.
